MIND. [1] [Caul.]
Fretful, weak of mind and memory. θ Miscarriage.
Fretful, irritable mood ; apprehension. θ False conception.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Caul.]
Headache, pressure behind eye, dimness of sight. θ Uterine derangement.
Severe headache over left eye. θ Miscarriage.
Headache aggravated : by stooping ; from light ; from noon until night. θ Miscarriage.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Caul.]
Heaviness of upper lids, has to raise them with fingers. θ Leucorrhœa.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Caul.]
"Moth spots" on forehead. θ Leucorrhœa.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Caul.]
Watery stools, great quantity, runs a perfect stream from bowels, but no pain ; 1 A. M. θ Cholera morbus.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Caul.]
Every few minutes sharp, stinging pain in glans penis. θ Gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Caul.]
Menses : too soon ; preceded by pain in small of back ; great aching and soreness of lower limbs ; bad breath ; bitter taste ; vertigo ; chilliness ; flow very scanty, blood very light, with intense nausea and vomiting of yellow, bitter matter ; pain unremitting for several hours ; habitual cold feet became warm under action of remedy.
Painful menstruation, flow being normal in quantity.
Spasmodic dysmenorrhœa ; spasmodic, intermittent pains in bladder, stomach, broad ligaments (groins), even chest and limbs ; congestion and irritability of uterus ; scanty flow.
Menstrual colic ; uterus retroverted.
Leucorrhœa : sharp, acrid, very weakening ; with heaviness of upper eyelids, has to lift them up with the fingers ; of profuse bland mucus ; with "moth spots" on forehead ; in little girls.
Leucorrhœa, with congestion of uterus and forcing down pains ; tardy appearance, or absence of menses, profuse secretion of mucus from vagina, and drawing pains in lower extremities.
Leucorrhœa in a woman, married ten years and never had a child ; in a few weeks became pregnant and was delivered in safety.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Caul.]
Threatened abortion ; all movement of child had ceased ; sense of weight, and profuse hemorrhage.
Paroxysms of labor pains so severe, patient had to hold on to objects for support ; threatened abortion at fourth month.
Spasmodic rigidity of os, delaying labor ; pains like pricking needles in cervix.
Labor pains short, irregular, spasmodic ; patient very weak and irritable ; no progress being made.
Pains become weak, flagging from long protracted labor, causing exhaustion ; thirsty, feverish.
Weak labor pains passing off with a shiver and causing much distress.
After pains : especially after exhausting lengthy labor ; spasmodic, across lower abdomen ; extend into groins.
Griping soreness of uterus, < from pressure.
After cessation of menses, occasional loss of blood ; fugitive pains in uterus and ovaries ; cervix swollen and congested ; os pouting and tightly closed ; feeling of tension and fulness in uterine region ; bloated abdomen. θ False conception.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Caul.]
Hoarseness and loss of voice. θ Uterine disturbances. θ leucorrhœa.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Caul.]
Panting breathing, oppression of chest. θ Uterine disturbances. θ Rheumatism.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Caul.]
Severe pains in back and loins. θ Threatening abortion.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Caul.]
Severe drawing pain in wrists and fingers.
Fingers are very stiff.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Caul.]
Drawing pains in thighs, knees, ankles, feet and toes.
   

NERVES. [36] [Caul.]
Tremulous weakness felt over entire body. θ Uterine hemorrhage.
Paraplegia, with retroversion and congestion of uterus after childbirth ; partial loss of sensation ; emaciation, anemia, general debility.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Caul.]
Sleepless, restless, nervous. θ Rheumatism. θ Uterine complaints.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Caul.]
Pains are intermittent and paroxysmal. θ Labor. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
